userRuleLiteral: the duration is 1 plank bubble length
correctionOf: v8.1 had no cycle-duration reference; v8.2 sets one full cycle to one user-defined plank bubble length

assumptions.plankBubbleLength: one complete Plank/Planck-length envelope in this model equals the CODATA Planck length l_P
assumptions.arcBubble: one of six geometric sub-arcs, length l_P/6, distinct from a complete plank bubble
assumptions.cycle: one 360-degree internal phase cycle comprised of 80 equal 1.25 percent steps
assumptions.conversion: For a time reported in seconds, use the explicitly selected null-trajectory light-travel equivalence t=L/c. This is a unit bridge, not a measured duration for a physical bubble.

duration.conversionType: conditional light travel time; not direct equation of dimensional length with time

phase.endConvention: n=80 is the completed cycle, at 360deg; next cycle starts at n=0

geometry.distinction: The full bubble length is l_P; one arc path in v7.9 is l_P/6; one v8.0 internal nominal arc-cycle length is 2.697e-36 m. These are not interchangeable.

restrictions: A length is not itself a time. The user's one-bubble-length duration is a normalized model reference; seconds are derived only through the explicit speed-of-light conversion.
The statement does not establish a physically measurable Planck-scale cycle or a minimum physical clock tick.
The 1.25-percent phase-time rule is a user-defined discrete phase convention.
The geometric per-arc length l_P/6 is distinct from the full bubble length l_P used as the duration reference.
All previous OASIS v7.x–v8.1 source files remain unchanged.
